text: Hello, and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好，欢迎收听《Real Easy English》，
zh_hant: 大家好，歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》，

text: the podcast where we have everyday conversations in easy English.
zh: 这是一档用简单英语进行日常对话的播客。
zh_hant: 這是一檔用簡單英語進行日常對話的播客。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Neil.
Don't forget to visit our website to find a text version of this podcast
zh: 别忘了访问我们的网站，找到本期播客的文字版，
zh_hant: 別忘了訪問我們的網站，找到本期播客的文字版，

text: so you can read along.
zh: 这样你就可以边听边看。
zh_hant: 這樣你就可以邊聽邊看。

text: Hi Neil, how are things?
I'm very well, thank you, Georgie.
And how about you?
How's your week going?
My week's going really well, thank you.
zh: 我这周过得非常好，谢谢。
zh_hant: 我這周過得非常好，謝謝。

text: And I'm excited because later I have choir practice.
zh: 我很兴奋，因为晚些时候我要去参加合唱团的排练。
zh_hant: 我很興奮，因為晚些時候我要去參加合唱團的排練。

text: Choir practice.
That means you sing with other people.
zh: 意思是你和别人一起唱歌。
zh_hant: 意思是你和別人一起唱歌。

text: It does.
Well, that's good, because we're talking all about hobbies.
zh: 那很好，因为我们今天要聊的就是兴趣爱好。
zh_hant: 那很好，因為我們今天要聊的就是興趣愛好。

text: And those are the activities that we do after work
or college or at the weekends.
zh: 或者放学后、或者在周末做的活动。
zh_hant: 或者放學後、或者在週末做的活動。

text: So, Neil, I go to choir.
Do you have any hobbies?
Yes, I also have a musical hobby.
zh: 有，我也有一个音乐方面的爱好。
zh_hant: 有，我也有一個音樂方面的愛好。

text: I like to play guitar.
Nice.
How often do you play the guitar?
It depends.
Sometimes I play for a long time, and often.
zh: 有时候我会弹很久，而且很频繁。
zh_hant: 有時候我會彈很久，而且很頻繁。

text: Usually, if I've heard a song I like, I want to learn how to play it.
zh: 通常，如果我听到一首喜欢的歌，我就想学着弹它。
zh_hant: 通常，如果我聽到一首喜歡的歌，我就想學著彈它。

text: And then sometimes I don't play at all for a while, for weeks.
zh: 但有时候我好几周完全都不弹。
zh_hant: 但有時候我好幾周完全都不彈。

text: Okay.
So you go through phases, I suppose.
zh: 所以我想，你是阶段性的。
zh_hant: 所以我想，你是階段性的。

text: Yeah.
And how about your choir?
Tell me more about that?
Well, so I go to choir practice weekly, every Monday.
zh: 好，我每周都去合唱团排练，每周一。
zh_hant: 好，我每週都去合唱團排練，每週一。

text: And at the moment, we're practicing for a Christmas concert.
zh: 目前我们在为一场圣诞音乐会排练。
zh_hant: 目前我們在為一場聖誕音樂會排練。

text: We did just do a concert, which was really fun.
zh: 我们刚办完一场音乐会，特别好玩。
zh_hant: 我們剛辦完一場音樂會，特別好玩。

text: And we've got another one, another one coming.
zh: 还有另一场，还有一场要来。
zh_hant: 還有另一場，還有一場要來。

text: Right.
Okay.
And do you really enjoy the singing?
How does it make you feel?
I love the singing because I put my phone in my bag
zh: 我很喜欢唱歌，因为我把手机放进包里，
zh_hant: 我很喜歡唱歌，因為我把手機放進包裡，

text: and I just sing with my friends,
zh: 就只管和朋友们一起唱，
zh_hant: 就只管和朋友們一起唱，

text: and we have a really nice group of people that do choir.
zh: 而且我们合唱团的人都特别好。
zh_hant: 而且我們合唱團的人都特別好。

text: So I really enjoy it.
So Neil, you like playing the guitar,
zh: 那么 Neil，你喜欢弹吉他，
zh_hant: 那麼 Neil，你喜歡彈吉他，

text: but maybe there's a new hobby you'd like to try?
zh: 但也许有新爱好你想尝试？
zh_hant: 但也許有新愛好你想嘗試？

text: Yeah, so I've been playing guitar for many years,
but I don't have any training and I can't read music.
zh: 但我没受过任何训练，也不识谱。
zh_hant: 但我沒受過任何訓練，也不識譜。

text: So I thought that maybe I should learn piano and learn properly.
zh: 所以我想也许我该学钢琴，正规地学。
zh_hant: 所以我想也許我該學鋼琴，正規地學。

text: Oh, that would be good.
Then you can play the piano with my choir.
zh: 那你可以和我的合唱团一起弹钢琴。
zh_hant: 那你可以和我的合唱團一起彈鋼琴。

text: Okay.
When do I start?
Next Monday.
So do you have any hobbies that aren't musical?
zh: 你有什么非音乐类的爱好吗？
zh_hant: 你有什麼非音樂類的愛好嗎？

text: Yes, I like doing some exercise.
So I like running and I like doing yoga.
zh: 我喜欢跑步，也喜欢做瑜伽。
zh_hant: 我喜歡跑步，也喜歡做瑜伽。

text: At the moment, I'm not running regularly.
zh: 目前我没有规律地跑步。
zh_hant: 目前我沒有規律地跑步。

text: I'm running probably monthly,
so once a month, which is not very good.
zh: 也就是每月一次，这不太好。
zh_hant: 也就是每月一次，這不太好。

text: I'd like to run more.
Yeah.
I also run, but I struggle to do it regularly.
zh: 我也跑步，但很难坚持规律地跑。
zh_hant: 我也跑步，但很難堅持規律地跑。

text: I think if you do it
twice or three times a week,
it's easy to keep going.
But once you stop, you stop for a long time.
zh: 但一旦停下来，就会停很久。
zh_hant: 但一旦停下來，就會停很久。

text: I completely agree.
It's difficult to stick to a routine with running, I find.
zh: 我觉得跑步很难保持规律。
zh_hant: 我覺得跑步很難保持規律。

text: It's very easy to lose your routine.
So, Georgie, you go to choir regularly,
zh: 那么 Georgie，你定期去合唱团，
zh_hant: 那麼 Georgie，你定期去合唱團，

text: but you don't run regularly.
What's this word, regularly?
zh: regularly 这个词是什么意思？
zh_hant: regularly 這個詞是什麼意思？

text: Well, regularly means that you do something often,
zh: regularly 意思是你经常做某事，
zh_hant: regularly 意思是你經常做某事，

text: as part of a regular routine.
So, for example,
I regularly get a coffee when I come to work.
So I get a coffee most times I come.
zh: 所以我大多数来上班的时候都会买咖啡。
zh_hant: 所以我大多數來上班的時候都會買咖啡。

text: But I don't regularly buy lunch.
I usually bring my own lunch from home.
Saves money.
Neil, what about unusual hobbies?
Do you have any unusual hobbies?
zh: 你有什么特别的爱好吗？
zh_hant: 你有什麼特別的愛好嗎？

text: I suppose I do.
I quite like making sauerkraut.
OK, sauerkraut.
What is sauerkraut?
It's a kind of food.
You get some cabbage and you slice it thinly and you add some salt,
zh: 你拿些卷心菜，切成薄片，加点盐，
zh_hant: 你拿些捲心菜，切成薄片，加點鹽，

text: you crush it and you leave it
and after a while it changes into something new
zh: 过一段时间它就变成一种新的东西，
zh_hant: 過一段時間它就變成一種新的東西，

text: which is very good for your stomach.
OK, so why do you like making sauerkraut, Neil?
zh: 好，那你为什么喜欢做酸菜，Neil？
zh_hant: 好，那你為什麼喜歡做酸菜，Neil？

text: It's very relaxing and it takes a while for It'd be right,
zh: 它很让人放松，而且要花些时间，
zh_hant: 它很讓人放鬆，而且要花些時間，

text: and I think in today's world we do lots of things that happen very quickly,
zh: 我觉得在当今世界，我们做的很多事都非常快，
zh_hant: 我覺得在當今世界，我們做的很多事都非常快，

text: so it's kind of old-fashioned but satisfying.
zh: 所以这有点老派，但让人有满足感。
zh_hant: 所以這有點老派，但讓人有滿足感。

text: Okay, makes sense.
I wouldn't do it, but I'm glad you have found something you love.
zh: 我不会做，但我很高兴你找到了自己喜欢的事。
zh_hant: 我不會做，但我很高興你找到了自己喜歡的事。

text: Well, let's recap the language we learned during the conversation.
zh: 好，我们来回顾一下对话中学到的语言。
zh_hant: 好，我們來回顧一下對話中學到的語言。

text: We had weekly, which means every week.
zh: 我们学了 weekly，意思是每周。
zh_hant: 我們學了 weekly，意思是每週。

text: Yes, and monthly, every month.
We had regularly, often.
We also heard the word choir,
zh: 我们还听到了 choir 这个词，
zh_hant: 我們還聽到了 choir 這個詞，

text: a group of people who sing together.
Yes.
Thanks for listening to Real Easy English.
Continue your learning on our website,
zh: 请在我们的网站上继续学习，
zh_hant: 請在我們的網站上繼續學習，

text: where you'll find worksheets and courses for all levels.
zh: 那里有适合各个级别的练习册和课程。
zh_hant: 那裡有適合各個級別的練習冊和課程。

text: Visit bbclearningenglish.com.
Next time, we'll talk about the things we do to stay healthy.
zh: 下次，我们要聊的是为了保持健康所做的事情。
zh_hant: 下次，我們要聊的是為了保持健康所做的事情。

text: Bye for now.
Bye.
